description: This file defines interfaces and constants for DNS Service Discovery (DNS-SD) in Zephyr OS, including functions for extracting query labels, matching records, and handling DNS-SD queries.

methods.name: dns_sd_query_extract
methods.description: Extract labels from a DNS-SD PTR query, returning number of bytes read or negative on failure.

methods.name: dns_sd_extract_service_proto_domain
methods.description: Extract service, protocol, and domain from a DNS-SD PTR query; deprecated.

methods.name: dns_sd_rec_match
methods.description: Check if a DNS-SD record matches a filter record.

methods.name: dns_sd_handle_ptr_query
methods.description: Handle a DNS PTR query for DNS Service Discovery, returning number of bytes written or negative on failure.

methods.name: dns_sd_handle_service_type_enum
methods.description: Handle a DNS Service Type Enumeration for DNS-SD, returning number of bytes written or negative on failure.
